item.title: Howling Offshores Create Insanely Long Barrels in Cape Town, South Africa
item.description: Howling offshores are nice, aren't they? If you're looking for long tubes, the tip of South Africa when all the stars align is a good place to start.

item.title: Surfer Still Hasn’t Gotten Refund After Airline Ran Over His Boards With a Stair Car
item.description: Welsh surfer William Beck had his board bag absolutely annihilated by an airline a few months ago and still has yet to see a dime for the destroyed equipment.

item.title: Jaws Lights Up as Season’s First XL West Swell Hits Maui
item.description: Well, it's that time of year again. It's the time that Jaws surfers live for: Peahi's opening day. A massive XL swell marched in from the west and Jaws lit up.

item.title: Gigi Rüf on Natural Selection, Making His Own Boards, and Snowboarding’s Power to Connect Us
item.description: Gigi Rüf does snowboarding differently than the rest of us. The Austrian ended last year's Natural Selection on the podium. And it was all about his attitude.

item.title: Faroe Islands Whale Hunters Face Criminal Charges
item.description: Police in the Faroe Islands have filed formal criminal charges against whalers participating in a traditional grindadráp, or grind, for the first time ever.

item.title: ‘Seven-Arm Octopus’ Filmed Alive In Incredibly Rare Footage From Monterey Bay
item.description: The seven-arm octopus is a strange creature. Researchers from the the Monterey Bay Aquarium and Research Institute shot some amazing footage of one.

item.title: Nate Florence and Kai Lenny Started Winter Off With an Irish Slab Hunt
item.description: When Nate Florence and Kai Lenny go to Ireland, they're going there to get super barreled. And get super barreled they did at Mullaghmore and Riley's.

item.title: Carlos Burle Suffers Scary Hold Down at Nazaré; Blames Handheld Camera for Complicating Rescue
item.description: After images emerged of Carlos Burle being rescued at Nazaré, the big-wave surfer took to Instagram to update fans that he had been released from the hospital.

item.title: Video Shows Woman Beckoning Bear Like It’s a Harmless Puppy
item.description: The good news is this video went viral just in time to become a leading contender for the 2025 Darwin Awards. As far as we know she still has both hands.

item.title: Mark Healey Surfed a Massive Outer Reef, and Waimea Bay, on the XL Thanksgiving Swell
item.description: Mark Healey surfed an outer reef during the XL Thanksgiving swell that hit the Hawaiian Islands. Afterwards, he headed to Waimea and snagged a few good ones.
